description: Scale, coverage and freshness of the PlaceProfile venue corpus. `countries` maps ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 codes to venue counts; a country absent from that map is NOT covered — treat an empty find_venues result there as no-coverage, never as evidence that no such venues exist. line_count is not a marketing claim: it is the line count of the downloadable manifest, independently checkable.
name: corpus_info
